tasks.title: Configure Product Template Block Order and Layout
tasks.description: Reorder blocks in product.json to match Merrachi reference: title → price → variant picker → buy buttons → description → accordions
tasks.details: Update templates/product.json to set block_order in _product-details section: ['title', 'price', 'variant-picker', 'buy-buttons', 'product-description', 'accordion']. Configure product-information section with desktop_media_position: 'left', content_width: 'large', equal_columns: false. Remove or reposition any divider blocks that break the reference flow. Use Shopify's latest section group schema format for optimal performance.
tasks.testStrategy: Manual verification: Load product page and confirm right column shows elements in correct order (title, price, variants, add-to-cart, description, accordions). Test on multiple products with different variant configurations.

subtasks.title: Update product.json block order configuration
subtasks.description: Modify the templates/product.json file to set the correct block order in the _product-details section
subtasks.details: Open templates/product.json and locate the _product-details section. Update the block_order array to: ['title', 'price', 'variant-picker', 'buy-buttons', 'product-description', 'accordion']. Ensure all block IDs match existing blocks in the template.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the product page displays blocks in the correct order by loading a product page and checking the right column sequence

subtasks.title: Configure product-information section layout settings
subtasks.description: Update the product-information section settings to match the Merrachi reference layout configuration
subtasks.details: In the product-information section of product.json, set desktop_media_position to 'left', content_width to 'large', and equal_columns to false. Use Shopify's latest section group schema format for optimal performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test on desktop to confirm media gallery appears on left side with large content width and unequal column layout

subtasks.title: Remove or reposition divider blocks
subtasks.description: Identify and remove or reposition any divider blocks that interrupt the reference flow pattern
subtasks.details: Scan through the product.json template to locate any divider blocks that break the intended flow (title → price → variant picker → buy buttons → description → accordions). Either remove these blocks entirely or move them to appropriate positions that don't disrupt the main content flow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manual verification to ensure no unwanted dividers appear between the main product detail blocks and the flow matches the reference

subtasks.title: Validate complete layout implementation
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the complete product template layout across multiple products and configurations
subtasks.details: Test the complete implementation on multiple products with different variant configurations. Verify the entire sequence works correctly: title → price → variant picker → buy buttons → description → accordions. Check responsive behavior and ensure all elements display properly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Load multiple product pages with different variant configurations and confirm the right column shows all elements in the correct order. Test on both desktop and mobile devices.

tasks.title: Configure Media Gallery for Vertical Portrait Layout
tasks.description: Set up product media gallery for vertical scrollable layout with portrait aspect ratio and right-side navigation
tasks.details: In product.json _product-media-gallery block, configure: media_presentation: 'grid' or 'list', aspect_ratio: '1/1.25' (portrait), thumbnail_position: 'right' if supported by theme. Set media_fit: 'contain' or 'cover' based on image quality. Configure slideshow_controls_style for dots navigation. If thumbnail_position 'right' not available, document for CSS override in task 6.
tasks.testStrategy: Visual verification: Gallery displays portrait images vertically, thumbnails or dots appear on right side of gallery. Test with products having multiple images. Verify navigation works correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Dynamic Title with Variant Name
tasks.description: Update product title to include selected variant name (e.g., 'Premium Jersey Prayer Skirt - Dark Cherry')
tasks.details: Modify title block in product.json to use Liquid: `{{ product.title }}{% if product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option1 and product.variants.size > 1 %} - {{ product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option1 }}{% endif %}`. Handle single-variant products gracefully. Ensure theme's variant change JavaScript updates the title dynamically using product-form.js event listeners and DOM manipulation.
tasks.testStrategy: Functional testing: Verify title shows product name with variant on page load. Change variants and confirm title updates dynamically. Test with single-variant products (no suffix should appear).

tasks.title: Style Product Details Typography and Layout
tasks.description: Update component-product.css to match Merrachi typography hierarchy for title, price, and labels
tasks.details: In assets/component-product.css, add/update rules: .product__title (h1: font-weight: 600, font-size: 1.8rem, line-height: 1.2), .product__price (font-weight: 600, font-size: 1.2rem, margin-top: 0.5rem), .product__option-label (font-size: 0.875rem, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.05em, margin-bottom: 0.5rem). Use CSS custom properties for consistent spacing and ensure mobile responsiveness with clamp() functions.
tasks.testStrategy: Visual regression testing: Compare typography with Merrachi reference screenshots. Test on desktop and mobile viewports. Verify text hierarchy is clear and readable.

subtasks.title: Define CSS Custom Properties for Typography Spacing
subtasks.description: Create CSS custom properties (variables) for consistent spacing values used across product typography elements
subtasks.details: In assets/component-product.css, define CSS custom properties at the root level for spacing values: --product-title-margin, --product-price-margin, --product-label-margin. Set values based on the 0.5rem spacing requirements and create a scalable system for future typography updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify custom properties are properly defined and can be referenced by other CSS rules. Test that changing a custom property value updates all dependent elements.

subtasks.title: Implement Product Title Typography Styles
subtasks.description: Style the .product__title element with specified font properties and responsive sizing using clamp() functions
subtasks.details: Update .product__title CSS rule with font-weight: 600, base font-size: 1.8rem, line-height: 1.2. Implement responsive typography using clamp() function for mobile-first approach (e.g., clamp(1.4rem, 4vw, 1.8rem)). Ensure proper heading hierarchy and accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visual testing on desktop and mobile viewports. Verify font scaling works smoothly across different screen sizes. Test with long product titles to ensure proper line wrapping.

subtasks.title: Style Product Price Typography
subtasks.description: Apply typography styles to .product__price element with proper spacing and responsive behavior
subtasks.details: Update .product__price CSS rule with font-weight: 600, font-size: 1.2rem, margin-top: 0.5rem (using custom property). Add responsive sizing with clamp() function for mobile optimization. Ensure price formatting and currency symbols display correctly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test price display across different product types (sale prices, compare-at prices). Verify spacing and alignment with title element. Test responsive behavior on mobile devices.

subtasks.title: Implement Product Option Label Styling
subtasks.description: Style .product__option-label elements with uppercase transformation, letter spacing, and proper margins
subtasks.details: Update .product__option-label CSS rule with font-size: 0.875rem, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.05em, margin-bottom: 0.5rem (using custom property). Add responsive considerations using clamp() for font-size. Ensure labels work with variant picker components.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with products having multiple variant options (size, color, etc.). Verify uppercase transformation and letter spacing render correctly. Test label spacing and alignment with form elements.

tasks.title: Style Variant Picker Components
tasks.description: Implement color swatches and size button styling to match Merrachi reference design
tasks.details: Update component-product.css for variant picker: Color swatches (.variant-input--swatch): 24px squares, border-radius: 2px, selected state with 2px border. Size buttons (.variant-input--button): horizontal layout, padding: 8px 16px, selected state with background: #000, color: #fff. Add hover states with opacity: 0.8. Use CSS Grid for consistent spacing: gap: 8px for swatches, gap: 12px for size buttons.
tasks.testStrategy: Interactive testing: Click color swatches and size buttons, verify visual feedback for selected/hover states. Test with products having different numbers of variants. Ensure accessibility with focus indicators.

tasks.title: Style Add to Cart Button and Gallery Navigation
tasks.description: Implement full-width black add-to-cart button and position gallery dots/thumbnails on the right
tasks.details: CSS for add-to-cart button (.product-form__cart-submit): width: 100%, background: #000, color: #fff, text-transform: uppercase, font-weight: 600, padding: 16px, border: none, border-radius: 0. For gallery navigation, if thumbnail_position 'right' not supported, add CSS: .product__media-gallery .thumbnails { position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); } or similar positioning for dots navigation.
tasks.testStrategy: Visual and functional testing: Verify button spans full width and has correct styling. Test add-to-cart functionality. Confirm gallery navigation appears on right side and functions correctly.

subtasks.title: Style Add to Cart Button with Full-Width Black Design
subtasks.description: Implement the full-width black styling for the add-to-cart button with uppercase text and proper padding
subtasks.details: Apply CSS styles to .product-form__cart-submit selector: width: 100%, background: #000, color: #fff, text-transform: uppercase, font-weight: 600, padding: 16px, border: none, border-radius: 0. Ensure the button spans the full width of its container and maintains consistent styling across different screen sizes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visual verification that button spans full width, has black background with white text, and maintains proper styling. Test add-to-cart functionality to ensure styling doesn't break button behavior.

subtasks.title: Analyze Gallery Navigation Positioning Requirements
subtasks.description: Determine if theme supports thumbnail_position 'right' or if CSS override is needed for gallery navigation
subtasks.details: Check the current theme's gallery component to see if thumbnail_position: 'right' is supported natively. If not supported, document the need for CSS positioning override. Identify the correct selectors for thumbnails or dots navigation elements in the gallery.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review theme documentation and test thumbnail_position setting. Inspect gallery HTML structure to identify navigation elements and their current positioning.

subtasks.title: Implement Right-Side Gallery Navigation Positioning
subtasks.description: Position gallery thumbnails or dots on the right side of the media gallery using CSS
subtasks.details: Add CSS to position gallery navigation on the right side: .product__media-gallery .thumbnails { position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }. If using dots navigation instead of thumbnails, apply similar positioning to the appropriate selector. Ensure navigation doesn't overlap with gallery images and remains accessible.
subtasks.testStrategy: Visual verification that gallery navigation appears on the right side of the gallery. Test navigation functionality to ensure thumbnails/dots still work correctly. Verify positioning works with different numbers of images.

subtasks.title: Test and Refine Gallery Navigation Styling
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the gallery navigation positioning and make refinements as needed
subtasks.details: Test the gallery navigation with products containing different numbers of images. Ensure the right-side positioning works correctly across different screen sizes. Make adjustments to spacing, alignment, or z-index if needed. Verify that the navigation doesn't interfere with other gallery functionality like zoom or lightbox features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Functional testing with multiple products having varying numbers of images. Test gallery navigation on different devices and screen sizes. Verify all gallery features work correctly with the new positioning.

tasks.title: Implement Accordion Styling with Plus Icons
tasks.description: Style product detail accordions to match Merrachi design with plus icons and minimal borders
tasks.details: Update accordion styles in component-product.css: .accordion__trigger with border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5, padding: 16px 0, position: relative. Add plus icon using ::after pseudo-element: content: '+', position: absolute, right: 0, font-size: 1.2rem. Expanded state changes plus to minus. .accordion__content with padding: 16px 0 0, max-height transitions for smooth animation. Use CSS transforms for icon rotation.
tasks.testStrategy: Interactive testing: Click accordion triggers to expand/collapse content. Verify plus/minus icon changes and smooth animations. Test with different content lengths in accordions.

tasks.title: Add Optional Breadcrumb Navigation
tasks.description: Implement breadcrumb navigation at the top of the product page (Home / Products / Product Title)
tasks.details: Create snippets/breadcrumb.liquid with structured data markup: Home link ({{ routes.root_url }}), Products link ({{ routes.collections_url }}/all or collection if available), current product title (no link). Add to product-information.liquid before main content. Style with small font-size: 0.875rem, color: #666, separated by ' / '. Include JSON-LD structured data for SEO benefits.
tasks.testStrategy: Navigation testing: Verify breadcrumb links work correctly. Test from different entry points (home, collection, search). Validate structured data with Google's Rich Results Test.

tasks.title: Add Size Guide Link Integration
tasks.description: Implement size guide link below size selector with proper styling and functionality
tasks.details: Add size guide link in variant-picker block or create new link block. Use section setting for URL (size_guide_url) or product metafield. Style as subtle link: font-size: 0.875rem, text-decoration: underline, color: #666, hover: color: #000. Position below size buttons with margin-top: 8px. Support multiple languages with locale keys ({{ 'products.size_guide' | t }}).
tasks.testStrategy: Functional testing: Verify link appears below size options and opens correct page. Test with products that have/don't have size guides. Verify localization works correctly.

tasks.title: Configure Product Recommendations Section
tasks.description: Set up 'You may also like' section with horizontal product cards and carousel functionality
tasks.details: Configure sections/product-recommendations.liquid with heading: 'You may also like' (localized), max_products: 4, layout: 'carousel' or 'grid'. Ensure product cards match collection-card styling: image aspect ratio 1/1.25, title, price. Add carousel dots below if using carousel layout. Use Shopify's product recommendations API with proper fallbacks. Implement lazy loading for images using loading='lazy' attribute.
tasks.testStrategy: Content and interaction testing: Verify 4 related products display correctly. Test carousel navigation if applicable. Verify product cards link to correct pages and match design reference.

subtasks.title: Create product-recommendations.liquid section file
subtasks.description: Create the base Liquid section file for product recommendations with proper schema configuration
subtasks.details: Create sections/product-recommendations.liquid with section schema including settings for heading text (localized), max_products (default 4), and layout options ('carousel' or 'grid'). Include proper section presets and blocks configuration. Set up basic HTML structure with section wrapper and container classes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify section appears in theme customizer with correct settings options and can be added to product templates

subtasks.title: Implement Shopify product recommendations API integration
subtasks.description: Integrate Shopify's product recommendations API with proper fallback handling for related products
subtasks.details: Use Shopify's recommendations object to fetch related products with limit based on max_products setting. Implement fallback logic to show products from same collection or vendor if recommendations API returns insufficient results. Handle cases where no recommendations are available with graceful degradation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various products to ensure 4 related products display, verify fallback logic works when recommendations are limited

subtasks.title: Build product cards with collection-card styling
subtasks.description: Create product cards that match existing collection-card styling with proper image aspect ratio and product information
subtasks.details: Build product cards with 1/1.25 aspect ratio images, product title, and price display. Ensure cards match collection-card styling for consistency. Implement lazy loading with loading='lazy' attribute on images. Add proper linking to product pages and ensure cards are responsive across devices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify product cards match design reference, test image lazy loading, confirm links work correctly and styling is consistent with collection cards

subtasks.title: Implement carousel functionality with navigation dots
subtasks.description: Add carousel layout option with horizontal scrolling and navigation dots below the product cards
subtasks.details: Implement carousel functionality when layout is set to 'carousel' with horizontal scrolling of product cards. Add navigation dots below the carousel for manual navigation. Ensure carousel is touch-friendly on mobile devices and includes proper accessibility attributes. Handle grid layout as alternative display option.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test carousel navigation with dots, verify touch scrolling on mobile, test grid layout option, ensure accessibility compliance for navigation elements

tasks.title: Implement Mobile Responsive Optimizations
tasks.description: Ensure all PDP components are properly responsive and match mobile reference design
tasks.details: Add mobile-specific CSS using media queries (@media (max-width: 768px)): Stack layout (media above, details below), adjust typography scales using clamp(), ensure touch targets are minimum 44px, optimize gallery for swipe gestures. Adjust spacing and padding for mobile: reduce margins, ensure add-to-cart button remains prominent. Test with iOS Safari and Chrome mobile for compatibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Cross-device testing: Test on various mobile devices and screen sizes. Verify touch interactions work correctly. Check performance with Lighthouse mobile audit. Ensure no horizontal scrolling occurs.

tasks.title: Perform Cross-Browser Testing and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing across browsers and optimize performance for production deployment
tasks.details: Test in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Verify CSS Grid/Flexbox compatibility, JavaScript functionality, and image loading. Optimize CSS with critical path extraction, compress images using Shopify's image transformation API (e.g., &width=800&height=1000), implement preload hints for above-the-fold images. Run Lighthouse audit targeting 90+ performance score. Test with slow 3G network simulation.
tasks.testStrategy: Comprehensive testing: Browser compatibility matrix testing, performance benchmarking with WebPageTest, accessibility audit with axe-core, visual regression testing comparing before/after screenshots across different browsers and devices.
